strings.subtitle: — Fael u Kwasen —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Zamber kwagh u a fatyô. Zamber kwagh u a we hii.
strings.ft_lnk: Uzenden kpishi (.lnk) — a fatyô u veren
strings.ssd_warning: Kera! Kwa SSD, ikyav u a fatyô u kwasen ga TRIM. Program u a kera HDD kwagh.
strings.confirm_text:
Fael "{name}" a gema u kwasen.

Dondon?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Fael kwagh u a fatyô u lengen:
{err}
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS uzenden u a we (ADS) kwagh u a er.
• USN ikyav u a zenden.
• Kwagh fan u a we u wingu
  (OneDrive u a we) kwagh u a kera.
strings.status_full: Kwagh cii a gema u zenda. Kwagh u a fatyô u zenden — ikyav i zenda kwagh.
strings.status_fast: Ityough, mkur u 4 MB imese a gema. Kwagh u a we kwagh u a er, shin zenden u a we, fael kwagh u a fatyô u zenden. Zamber ikyav u KPO kwagh u a kera.
strings.status_empty: Fael zenda, gema kwagh u a fatyô. Kwasen.
strings.error_permission: Kwagh u a fatyô u zamber fael. A we program u a we. Zenden u a we.
strings.error_not_found: Fael kwagh u a fatyô. A kwasen a we.
strings.error_is_symlink: U a we uzenden u a we. Uzenden kwagh u a fatyô u kwasen — fael u a we a we.
strings.error_reparse: U a we fael u a we (OneDrive u a we). Kwagh u a we wingu, kwagh u a we disk — kwagh u a kwasen.
strings.error_not_file: U a we fael (folder u a we). Zamber fael.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fael u a we uzenden u a we ({n} cii). Uzenden u a we uzenden u a we — ityough cii we. U kwasen uzenden u a we, kwagh a gema u 32 byte, shin uzenden u a we a fatyô u zamber. Kwasen uzenden cii kwagh.
strings.error_compressed:
Fael a ban, a simba u a we sparse. Gema u zenda kwagh u a fatyô u kwasen kwagh u a we, NTFS a we kwagh u a we.

Zenden sifa: bofya u a we → Sifa → Kina → zenden "Ban" u a we "Simba". Zamber SHREDDER.
